verdict.rationale: Mem0 is a memory-layer service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. First-party docs describe a Mem0 MCP server that gives agents memory tools, connects any AI client via Model Context Protocol, and offers a hosted server clients can point at with a single command; a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use, and detailed documentation of the full tool set and per-client setup.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Mem0 MCP server hands your agent a set of memory tools, so it can decide for itself when to save something, look something up, or update what it already knows.
Connect any AI client to Mem0 using Model Context Protocol in minutes
Point your clients at the hosted server with a single command
official MCP server documented at https://docs.mem0.ai/platform/mem0-mcp
